definition: Noisy and full of lively, uncontrolled energy.
author: Lyman Frank Baum
quote: A chorus of boisterous laughter came from the other rocks, and Dorothy saw hundreds of the armless Hammer-Heads upon the hillside, one behind every rock.
example_sentence: The boisterous puppies tumbled across the lawn.
